Title: Create city-level Eurostat analytical matrix

Output requirements:

<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
# Import necessary libraries
import pandas as pd

# Load the input data
df = pd.read_csv('t02_eurostat_raw.csv')

# Pivot the data to create a city-year by indicator matrix
df_pivot = df.pivot(index=['city_id', 'year'], columns='indicator_id', values='value')

# Reset the index to include city_id and year as columns
df_pivot = df_pivot.reset_index()

# Fill missing values with empty string
df_pivot = df_pivot.fillna('')

# Write the output to a CSV file
df_pivot.to_csv('t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv', index=False)
</solution_file>
